let sig (r : Nat) : Nat :=
  let wires := ([(false,0,1), (false,3,9), (true,15,27), (true,17,26), (true,13,26), (true,13,27), (false,2,6)] : List (Bool × Nat × Nat)).foldl
    (fun (z : Nat × Nat) g =>
      let a := z.1.testBit g.2.1
      let b := z.1.testBit g.2.2
      (z.1 ||| ((if g.1 then a && b else a || b).toNat <<< z.2), z.2 + 1)) (r,26)
  wires.1 ||| ((if wires.1.testBit 32 then wires.1 else 0) <<< 33)
let Gate : Type := Bool × Nat × Nat
let Row : Type := Nat → Bool
let initial (v : Nat) : Row := fun i => decide (i < 33) && v.testBit i
let write (r : Row) (n : Nat) (v : Bool) : Row := fun i => if i = n then v else r i
let physical (s : Row) (t : Gate) := if t.1 then s t.2.1 && s t.2.2 else s t.2.1 || s t.2.2
let physStep (state : Nat × Row) (t : Gate) : Nat × Row :=
  (state.1+1,write state.2 state.1 (physical state.2 t))
let execute (gs : List Gate) (out v : Nat) := (gs.foldl physStep (33,initial v)).2 out
let classify (t : Gate) : Option Nat :=
  if t.2.1 = 32 then some t.2.2 else if t.2.2 = 32 then some t.2.1 else none
let paid (t : Gate) := t.1 && (classify t).isNone
∀ (gs : List Gate) (out : Nat),
  (∀ k, execute gs out (sig (pos k)) = true) →
  (∀ i, execute gs out (sig (neg i)) = false) →
  9 ≤ gs.countP paid
